en.headline: Mark Six first prize rolls over after no winner in 111th draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said the winning numbers were 3, 13, 27, 29, 30 and 40, with special number 9, and the jackpot will carry forward.
body: No one matched all six numbers in Saturday’s Mark Six draw, sending the first-prize fund into the next round.
The Hong Kong Jockey Club drew the numbers 3, 13, 27, 29, 30 and 40, with the special number 9, in the 111th draw of 2026. Total turnover was about HK$47.8 million.

One and a half units matched five numbers plus the special number and shared the second-prize pool of about HK$1.68 million. The next draw is scheduled for Tuesday, with an estimated first-prize fund of about HK$19 million.
Tickets for the next draw close at 9.15pm on Tuesday. The Jockey Club reminds players that Mark Six is restricted to those aged 18 and over.

zh.headline: 六合彩第111期頭獎無人中 基金滾存至下期
zh.dek: 馬會公布中獎號碼為3、13、27、29、30及40，特別號碼9，下期頭獎估計約一千九百萬元。
body: 周六的六合彩攪珠無人中頭獎，頭獎基金將滾存至下期。
香港賽馬會第111期攪珠抽出3、13、27、29、30及40，特別號碼為9。總投注額約四千七百八十萬元。
二獎有1.5注中，共分得約一百六十八萬元。下期攪珠訂於周二舉行，估計頭獎基金約一千九百萬元。
下期售票於周二晚上九時十五分截止。馬會提醒，六合彩只限十八歲或以上人士投注。
